paragraphs: Chapter 817
Episode 204. Declaration of War (4)
At the same time, Zipfel was being attacked in two more areas by the Red Tribe.

The Red Tribe had begun their invasions on the 1st class magic tower in the autonomous district of Kyu-un and the Tower of Stories. However, unlike in the autonomous district of Rislit, the invasions weren't led by an aerial fortress but a fleet.

"As expected of Zipfel, they're doing well in combat even though their fleet seems considerably outnumbered," Quikantel said. She, along with Valkas and Lata, had infiltrated the autonomous district of Kyu-un with the help of the unnamed top assassin, Bejen.
The Red Tribe fleet attacking Kyu-un's magic tower consisted of approximately two hundred ships, led by Battle King Rakiman.
On the other hand, Zipfel's fleet stationed at the tower was about a hundred and fifty ships strong. It was clear that Zipfel was falling behind both in terms of technology and quantity.

However, Octavia and her guardian dragon, Sallion, were currently in Kyu-un. As soon as the dimension door opened, she ascended to the top of the tower, casting spells and exhibiting tremendous power to hold off the Red Tribe fleet.
"It seems to be due to Octavia Zipfel," said Valkas.

"True, Valkas. If it weren't for Octavia, the balance of power would have tilted quickly. Zipfel's Grand Mage becomes most powerful when supported by her guardian dragon and the magic tower. She's even stronger than she was during the War of the Evil Gods. It seems she's gained enlightenment."

The situation in Kyu-un was developing entirely differently from what Mary and her group had witnessed at Rislit tower. It was only natural considering the Red Tribe did not have an aerial fortress and Zipfel had one of the most powerful individuals.
Regardless of them being enemies, the group could not help but be astounded by Octavia's power. It wasn't an exaggeration to say that her strength alone was deciding the outcome of the battle.
"I don't know how much you've underestimated our Zipfel to provoke us like this, but today, you'll pay for your arrogance!"
The flagship of the Zipfel 2nd Fleet, Lucia, was positioned in front of Octavia, who had sustained injuries. Octavia stood at the forefront of Lucia, her eyes flashing red.
Crash!
The crimson eye of magic, a special secret skill that had driven Jin to his limits during the past Sword Emperor War, was corroding the entire sky with fire.
The storm generated by the Dragon Sallion was carrying the crimson wind towards the Red Tribe fleet. The spread of flames like a plague caused the Red Tribe fleet to falter and stop firing.

They had to focus more energy on their defense. To sustain the protective shield, the Red Tribe fleet had to abandon their scattered formation and concentrate in one place. Consequently, Octavia and the magic tower also focused their firepower in response.
"Flagship Lucia, charge! I'll personally break their formation into pieces."
"Captain, we're still in the early stages of the battle. Wouldn't it be too risky?"

"Thinking about what will come after the fight, we cannot win against these aliens, the Red Plutonian Tribe. Surely, other towers are being invaded too. The signal sent by the Tower Master's staff means that Lisleit has already been defeated. We, at least, must win at all costs!"
"Understood, we will gather the entire first line of the Phantom Troops!"
The scattered Phantom Troops, from various ships and towers, began to gather at the flagship Lucia.

Octavia seemed to be prepared to face death with a grave face. There was no future for Zephyr if all regions fell in the first battle, where the war declaration and the strike zone were announced in advance.
That desperation fueled Octavia's fury. The light magic held by her staff was endlessly sharp, and the Phantom Troops that gathered behind her exuded an intense bloodlust.
There was no resurrection stone here.

Therefore, if Octavia and the Phantom Troops died, there was a high chance they could not resurrect again. Even if the corpses were recovered and resurrection succeeded later, they could never be fully restored. It wasn't an empty talk to exclude the consequences.
"Collision in 5 seconds! 4, 3, 2......!"
Kwaddddduk-!
The bow of the flagship Lucia hit the shield of the Red Fleet. The bow was instantly shattered, and a corresponding crack appeared on the shield of the Red Fleet.

The Red Plutonian Tribe, who had been waiting on the ship, fired their energy with their hearts glowing. Octavia and the Phantom Troops repelled the energy with their magic and staffs and entered the enemy ship in a breath.
"Lucia, keep ramming until it breaks apart completely! We're going all the way into their flagship!"

Octavia's eyes still burned with crimson flame. The ordinary soldiers felt their bodies burn and crumble just by making eye contact with her, and even the high-ranking combatants who managed to hold out better, dared not to approach her.
The ship-to-ship bombardment continued. Not only the two fleets, but also the surface that endured the bombardment and its debris were vibrating as if it was about to break apart.
Already, more than 50 ships, counting both sides, had been broken. The Red Plutonian Tribe expected a simple victory, but what they were experiencing now was an intense melee.
"It may not be as powerful as Jin Runcandel, but that power is too much to be considered human. Octavia Zephyr, the Phantom Commander of Zephyr, right?"
Rakiman, from his bridge, spoke as he watched Octavia and the Phantom Troops.
"That's correct, Rakiman compatriot. She is the de facto second in command of Zephyr. Her momentum is ferocious, but it seems impossible for her to get here."
"Compatriot Andolin, you still lack the ability to judge. If I do not finish her myself, this invasion will surely fail."
"But Rakiman, you're still wounded."
Rakiman was still not fully recovered from the injury inflicted by Jin.

"It's to win. Even if compatriot Shimat were here, he would have the same opinion. Drive away the ships placed in front of the flagship Laviet, and open the bridge. I will handle it myself. And all the first-class fighters on each ship, prepare to confront the Phantom Troops!"
The ships lined up in front of Lafayette spread out, and Octavia grinned. Far away, the figure of Rakiman was visible.
"I am Rakiman Hog, the Grand Duke of the Red Plutonian tribe. You seem to possess worthy blood, Octavia Zephyr."
"Ah, Rakiman Hog. The fool who fearlessly rushed at Runcandel's alcohol and was shattered. I assume you've already written your last will and testament?"
"Haha... It seems we're in a position where we can't afford to be disgraced any further. It won't be as easy for you as it was that day."
"Lucia, charge!"
Kujizizik-!
As soon as the order fell, Lucia increased its speed and charged towards the Red Plutonian tribe's ship where Octavia had been standing.
The ship split in half, and Sallion fixed Octavia and the Ghost Legion in the wind and sent them back to the broken bow of Lucia.

And Lucia continued to advance at full speed towards Lafayette, using Sallion's wind as propulsion. In the meantime, the cannons of Lafayette hit Lucia several times, but they lost their power being countered by the consecutive magic of Octavia and the Ghost Legion.

Eventually, Lucia and Lafayette collided, causing a tremendous shockwave. The nearby fleets were pushed back, and more than half of the crew members of the two ships lost their lives in the aftermath.

Octavia and Rakiman even glared at each other, engulfed by the sensation of their bodies breaking in a moment. The moment Rakiman's sword and Octavia's staff collided, the two interlocked ships couldn't withstand the pressure and began to slowly fall.
If Lafayette had not been damaged by Jin's Sovereign Sword and Fire earlier, only Lucia would have crashed and broken.
But now the two ships had similar defensive capabilities. Although the average performance of the fleet was superior in the Red Plutonian tribe, there was not a big difference between the flagships.

The first-class warriors of the Red Plutonian tribe were intruding towards the two crashing flagships. The Ghost Legion scattered and dealt with the warriors, and Octavia fixed her gaze only on Rakiman.
Numerous spells, enemy brains, swords, and staff crisscrossed, distorting the air. Octavia and Rakiman were already full of phantom wounds all over their bodies.
The fall of the flagships was coming to an end. Already, a large hole made by the shockwave was formed in the ground where the two ships were falling.
"Ghost Legion, scatter and avoid the shock!"
"Dukes, disperse!"
Octavia and Rakiman yelled. If their flagships hit the ground and exploded, the rest could not survive the aftermath.
The moment the Ghost Legion and the Dukes threw their bodies outside the flagship.
Octavia and Rakiman were preparing their respective trump cards, each aiming their weapons at each other.
"Damn, Captain!"
"Grand Duke Brother…!"
Ching, Phereong...!
Soon after, the two flagships crashed, and the sequence of magic and enemy brains spewing out continued. A huge white and red pillar was piercing the sky.

The spectral squad and the warrior kings couldn't withstand the horrific explosion. All fleets temporarily stopped their bombardment to observe the scene. The massive ships were shaking violently as if they were tiny boats in a storm.
The explosion continued for over 3 minutes. When the heat finally subsided a little and the flagship could be seen with the naked eye, Octavia was the first to emerge from the rubble.
"Phew, Huk, Kuk...!"
She was spitting up blood and glaring at the pit. The spectral squad and the warrior kings were able to confirm that the final result had not been decided yet.

After a while, Rakiman emerged from the other side of the wreckage, looking in far worse condition than Octavia. Deep wounds, enough to expose his bones, were all over his body, and blood was spurting from the gaps every time he moved.
However, his core was even brighter than before. Rakiman gripped his glowing core and smiled faintly.
[It's been a while since I've transformed...]
The great warrior king had transformed for battle. Once he completed his transformation, he took the form of a huge, red snake, looking nothing like the exhausted figure from before.
[Did you think you had the upper hand, Octavia Zipfel? Disappointed face.]
"I still have plenty of cards to play. Come, I will finish this!"
Octavia spat out the blood and lifted her staff again.
Tower of Tales.
"The spectral squad leader is holding on well."
Veradin said, looking at the sky. He was able to understand the situation without having to see the scene directly.
In the sky, Zipfel's 1st fleet and the red fleet were engaged in a bombardment battle.
Zipfel's fleet had a significant advantage in numbers. The red fleet that invaded consisted of about 70 ships, while almost 500 ships were stationed at the Tower of Tales.
"That's a relief."
Satrine bowed her head in response.

"So we should deal with them as soon as possible and support the spectral squad leader. It seems that they just came to take a look at the Tower of Tales today. They will probably retreat soon by opening a dimensional gate."
"I think so too, Governor. They probably only sent 70 ships because they relied on large-scale teleportation."
"But, it is necessary to show them that there are situations where they cannot escape."
"…Do you have a way to capture them?"
"Open the tower, judge. I will manipulate their dimensional gate. The 70 red race ships that came to the Tower of Tales today will not be able to escape a single one
